note: Canonical three-way monocyte subsetting on CD14 × CD16, with four populations forming distinct clusters. Classical_monocytes: horizontal blob along the upper band (CD14 high, CD16 low-to-mid; CD14++ CD16-/lo). Intermediate_monocytes: small cluster at the upper-right (CD14 high, CD16 high). Patrolling_monocytes: cluster at the mid-right (CD14 mid/dim, CD16 high) — sits below the Intermediate cluster along the right edge. Non_monocytes: broad lower band at CD14 low, often with two density centers — a left center at CD16 low and a right center at CD16 high (CD14-low residual including some CD16+ non-monocyte events). Feeds the DC branch downstream.
tips: Canonical three-way monocyte subsetting on CD14 × CD16. Classical_monocytes: CD14++ CD16-. Intermediate_monocytes: CD14++ CD16+. Patrolling_monocytes: CD14+ CD16++. Non_monocytes: CD14-low. Useful co-markers: HLA-DR confirms monocyte identity (all subsets are HLA-DR+) and is used at Step 14 to enrich the DC branch within Non_monocytes.
